description: CAEBAT OAS is an open-source software tool listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Battery", published or maintained by vibe.ornl.gov (publisher inferred from the link). a flexible and computationally scalable open-architecture framework that integrates multi-physics and multi- scale battery models. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Battery" (battery storage). The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support battery storage studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
